caption: The drawing features three detailed views of a single iron object. The main object, shown in perspective at the lower center, is a trivet with three short legs and a long, straight handle ending in a loop. The central surface of the trivet is triangular with convex sides and contains three internal scroll designs, one large and two smaller, all made of the same iron material. Above the main perspective view, there is a top-down view and a side profile of the object, both rendered in the same monochrome grey, matching the hand-drawn graphite or pencil medium. The top view shows the scrollwork and the overall shape of the trivet, while the side view clarifies the height of the legs and the flatness of the handle in relation to the trivet base. A small scale in centimeters is included next to the side view for measurement reference. The background is a plain, off-white or cream paper with some visible spots and subtle discoloration. The lower right corner contains the printed name "HOLGER HANSEN."
title: Trivet
